skill.name: context7-auto-research
skill.description: Fetch current library and framework documentation through Context7 for use in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code conversations.
skill.summary: Research current developer documentation without leaving your AI coding conversation.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Both static findings are false positives. One is a fenced installation example, and the other is a Markdown repository link; neither executes automatically. No prompt injection or malicious intent appears in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: Lines 19-21 are a fenced Bash installation example in Markdown, not Ruby backtick syntax or automatically executed code.
Line 29 contains a Markdown link to the skill repository. It does not initiate a network request or transmit data.

content.value_statement: Library guidance becomes outdated as frameworks change. This skill retrieves current documentation through Context7 during AI coding conversations.
actual_capabilities: Fetches current library and framework documentation through the Context7 API.
Supports research requests about React, Next.js, Prisma, and other popular libraries.
Works through natural requests in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code conversations.
Supports optional API key configuration for higher rate limits.
Can activate automatically when a conversation requires library documentation.
limitations: Coverage and freshness depend on documentation available through Context7.
Higher request volumes may require an API key.
The skill does not replace testing against the target project and environment.
Ambiguous library names or versions may require clarification.

use_cases.title: Check Framework Changes
use_cases.description: Retrieve current framework documentation before updating an application or adopting a changed API.

use_cases.title: Verify Library Guidance
use_cases.description: Confirm current library behavior while reviewing implementation plans, examples, or technical recommendations.

use_cases.title: Prepare Accurate Tutorials
use_cases.description: Research current documentation before writing lessons, migration notes, or internal developer guides.

prompt_templates.title: Find Current Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the latest documentation for [library] about [feature]. Summarize the recommended approach and identify any version requirements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a focused documentation question.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Framework Versions
prompt_templates.prompt: Research how [feature] differs between [framework version A] and [framework version B]. Cite the relevant documentation and summarize migration concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Validate an Implementation Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Check current [library] documentation against this implementation plan: [plan]. Identify unsupported assumptions, required configuration, and recommended changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use during technical planning or review.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Multi-Library Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Research the current documentation for [library A], [library B], and [framework]. Explain integration constraints, version compatibility, and unresolved questions.

output_examples.input: Find the current Next.js guidance for server-side data fetching.
output_examples.output: A concise summary of supported data-fetching methods, version-specific guidance, important constraints, and links to relevant documentation.

output_examples.input: Compare the Prisma migration workflow across two specified versions.
output: A summary of workflow changes between the requested versions.
A list of migration risks and required configuration checks.
References to the relevant Prisma documentation.

output_examples.input: Validate my React library integration plan against current documentation.
output_examples.output: A review that separates documented requirements, questionable assumptions, recommended revisions, and items requiring project-level testing.

best_practices: Specify the library, version, and feature whenever possible.
Configure an API key through environment variables when higher rate limits are required.
Verify recommendations in the target project before changing production code.
anti_patterns: Do not request broad research without naming the relevant library or framework.
Do not assume documentation examples match every project configuration.
Do not treat retrieved guidance as a substitute for testing or expert review.

faq.question: What does this skill research?
faq.answer: It retrieves current documentation for libraries and frameworks available through Context7.

faq.question: Does it support React, Next.js, and Prisma?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explicitly supports questions about these tools and other popular libraries.

faq.question: Is a Context7 API key required?
faq.answer: No. An API key is optional, but it can provide higher rate limits.

faq.question: Can it research a specific version?
faq.answer: You can request a version, but results depend on the documentation available through Context7.

faq.question: Does it change project files?
faq.answer: The documented skill focuses on retrieving information. Review and apply any resulting changes separately.

faq.question: Should retrieved guidance be tested?
faq.answer: Yes. Validate recommendations against your project version, configuration, and runtime environment.
